# positional distance

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:metricPositionalDistance`](gmeow-metricPositionalDistance.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/metricPositionalDistance>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

Absolute difference between coordinates on a linear 1-D frame (base pairs, amino-acid residues, sequence indices). Interval length (|end - start| + 1 for inclusive ranges) is a distinct metric.
